note: Hand-kept product data of the EDGE Screener (EXEC-SCREENER, report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.12): the non-indicator metrics with the Feature_Catalog fields, the transform functions and their argument ranges, and the periods block (P23 a). Availability is derived at run time from `requires` against the state.json xsection index and `decision` (validate.ts availabilityOf); nothing here is enumerated in code. Ranges marked by the cost note are provisional.
cost_note: PROVISIONAL (P5, decided with the go 2026-10-28): replaced by the Phase 17 measurement

transforms.label: Distance from a price level, %
transforms.formula: (close / x - 1) x 100 on each bar; null where x is missing or 0
transforms.interpretation: How far the close is above (positive) or below (negative) a price level such as a moving average or a 52-week high.
transforms.misuse: Only for a price level (an output comparable with close); a percent distance from an oscillator has no meaning.
transforms.evidence: report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.9.1 line and price_ma rows; verification/screener/audit/html_model.md section 2.1

transforms.label: Position in the band, %
transforms.formula: (close - lower) / (upper - lower) x 100 on each bar, upper and lower of the same band instance; null at zero width (raw doubles, no epsilon)
transforms.interpretation: 0 at the lower band, 100 at the upper band, 50 at the middle; below 0 or above 100 outside the band.
transforms.misuse: Undefined (NA NULL_AT_EVALUATION) when the band has zero width, for example on a flat window.
transforms.evidence: report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.9.1 band row (changed: NA only at zero width, R14)

transforms.label: Value N sessions earlier
transforms.formula: x[i - bars] on the ticker's own bars; null before
transforms.interpretation: The same series shifted back; "rising" is x above its own value N sessions earlier.
transforms.misuse: Counts the ticker's own sessions, not calendar days.
transforms.evidence: report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.9.1 rising rows (5 for lines, 21 for price_ma, 20 for cumulative lines)

transforms.label: Change over N sessions
transforms.formula: x[i] - x[i - bars] (absolute); null when either is missing
transforms.interpretation: Positive when the series rose over the last N sessions. On a cumulative line it is offset-invariant, so it does not depend on where history starts.
transforms.misuse: An absolute change: compare it only with values of the same unit.
transforms.evidence: report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.7 (cumulative lines offered only as change, ratio, N-bar high and level vs its own MA)

transforms.label: Highest value of the last N sessions
transforms.formula: max of x over [i - length + 1, i], today included; a missing value restarts the window (the indicators.ts roll rule)
transforms.interpretation: The N-session high; the 52-week high is rolling_max(high, 252) (P23 a).
transforms.misuse: Includes today, so a close can never be above rolling_max(high) on the same bar: as the right side of a price comparison it is read on the previous bar (compare_lag, derived by the lag probe).
transforms.evidence: report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.8 lag probe, 6.9.1 hi52 row; TEST PLAN 10b.3 same-bar comparison lag

transforms.label: Lowest value of the last N sessions
transforms.formula: min of x over [i - length + 1, i], today included; a missing value restarts the window
transforms.interpretation: The N-session low; the 52-week low is rolling_min(low, 252) (P23 a).
transforms.misuse: Includes today, so a close can never be below rolling_min(low) on the same bar: as the right side of a price comparison it is read on the previous bar (compare_lag).
transforms.evidence: report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.8 lag probe, 6.9.1 lo52 row

transforms.label: Consecutive rising sessions
transforms.formula: number of consecutive bars ending at i with x[t] > x[t - 1]; 0 when x[i] <= x[i - 1]; null when x[i] or x[i - 1] is missing
transforms.interpretation: The MACD histogram "rising 3 sessions" of the prototype is rising_run(histogram) above 2.
transforms.misuse: Counts sessions, not size: a run of tiny increases counts as much as a run of large ones.
transforms.evidence: report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.9.1 macd hup row

transforms.label: Moving average of a series
transforms.formula: indicators.ts sma (SMA) or ema (EMA, seeded with the SMA of its first n valid values) of x, the reference helpers, never a copy
transforms.interpretation: A line above its own average is trending up; the prototype's "above its N-session average" for OBV, PVT and A/D is this EMA (label changed from "average" to "EMA").
transforms.misuse: An EMA of a cumulative line is computed on full history and depends on its start (labelled, report 6.7).
transforms.evidence: report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.9.1 cum row; verification/screener/audit/html_model.md section 2.2 obv

transforms.label: Ratio of two series
transforms.formula: x / by on each bar; null where by is 0 or either is missing
transforms.interpretation: The volume spike ratio is ratio(volume, lag(ma(volume, SMA, 20), 1)): today's volume over the average of the previous 20 sessions.

transforms.label: Return minus IHSG return
transforms.formula: (close[i] / close[i - window] - IHSG[i] / IHSG[i - window]) x 100 on the ticker's own bars, IHSG close aligned to the ticker's dates by datafile.asOf
transforms.interpretation: Points by which the stock beat (positive) or lagged (negative) the index over the window.
transforms.misuse: Not a percentile: use return_rank to compare across stocks.
transforms.evidence: report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.9 rs row; verification/screener/audit/html_model.md section 2.1 rs

transforms.label: Against its own average
transforms.formula: A = SMA or EMA of x over the N sessions before today (indicators.ts sma / ema read one session back); difference x - A, ratio x / A, percent 100 x (x / A - 1); null where x or A is missing, and for ratio and percent where A <= 0
transforms.interpretation: How far today's value is above (positive) or below (negative) its own recent average, today left out of the average.
transforms.misuse: On a series that can be zero or negative (an oscillator around 0) use the difference form; ratio and percent need a positive average.
transforms.evidence: verification/screener/OPERATORS.md (approved by the user 2026-11-07, K4), operator 2

transforms.label: Percentile of its own history
transforms.formula: 100 x (number of the N earlier values below x + half the number equal to x) / number of earlier values (mid-rank); the N sessions before today; null with fewer than N sessions of history
transforms.interpretation: 0 to 100: where today's value stands among its own last N sessions; 90 means higher than about 90% of them.
transforms.misuse: A percentile of a series that is already a percentile or a z-score is not offered: it would compare the series with its own history twice.
transforms.evidence: verification/screener/OPERATORS.md (approved by the user 2026-11-07, K4), operator 3

transforms.label: Z-score against its own history
transforms.formula: (x - mean) / sample standard deviation (n - 1) of the N sessions before today; null with fewer than N sessions of history, fewer than 2 values or a zero deviation
transforms.interpretation: How many standard deviations today's value is from its own recent mean; above 2 is unusually high.
transforms.misuse: Assumes the recent values are a fair baseline; after a regime change the z-score stays extreme for a while.
transforms.evidence: verification/screener/OPERATORS.md (approved by the user 2026-11-07, K4), operator 6

transforms.label: Change over N sessions, %
transforms.formula: 100 x (x[i] / x[i - bars] - 1); null where either is missing or the earlier value is <= 0
transforms.interpretation: The percent change of the series over the last N sessions.
transforms.misuse: Needs a positive earlier value; for a series around zero use the change in points (change).
transforms.evidence: verification/screener/OPERATORS.md (approved by the user 2026-11-07, K4), operator 4

transforms.label: Compared with another series
transforms.formula: difference x - by, or ratio x / by (null where by <= 0), on each bar; null where either is missing; both series must have the same unit
transforms.interpretation: How far one series is from another of the same unit, for example the close against a moving average, or one oscillator against another.
transforms.misuse: Only for two series of the same unit: a price with a price, a percent with a percent; a price against an oscillator is refused.
transforms.evidence: verification/screener/OPERATORS.md (approved by the user 2026-11-07, K4), operator 7

transforms.label: Slope over N sessions
transforms.formula: ordinary least-squares slope of x over the N sessions ending today against the session index; in the unit of x per session; null where any value of the window is missing
transforms.interpretation: Positive while the series trends up over the window, negative while it trends down; larger means steeper.
transforms.misuse: A straight-line fit: a sharp turn inside the window can leave a small slope.
transforms.evidence: verification/screener/OPERATORS.md (approved by the user 2026-11-07, K4), operator 12

transforms.label: Acceleration over N sessions
transforms.formula: slope of the last N sessions minus the slope of the N sessions before them; null where either slope is missing
transforms.interpretation: Positive when the trend is getting steeper (or a fall is slowing), negative when it is losing pace.
transforms.misuse: Reads 2N sessions; a short N reacts to noise.
transforms.evidence: verification/screener/OPERATORS.md (approved by the user 2026-11-07, K4), operator 13

transforms.label: Distance to its high or low
transforms.formula: x - the highest (or lowest) x of the N sessions ending today, today included (a missing value restarts the window); percent 100 x (x / extreme - 1), null where the extreme is <= 0
transforms.interpretation: How far today's value is below its N-session high (0 at the high) or above its N-session low (0 at the low).
transforms.misuse: Today is included, so the distance to the high is never above 0; percent needs a positive extreme.
transforms.evidence: verification/screener/OPERATORS.md (approved by the user 2026-11-07, K4), operator 14

metrics.label: Distance from 52W high
metrics.formula: (close / highest high of the last 252 sessions, today included - 1) x 100
metrics.interpretation: Near 0: at the 52-week high; -25: 25% below it.
metrics.misuse: Uses 252 sessions as one year, not the prototype's 250. A stock with fewer than 252 sessions of history has no value (n/a: not enough history).
metrics.evidence: verification/screener/audit/html_model.md section 2.1 hi52; report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.9.1 hi52 row

metrics.label: Distance from 52W low
metrics.formula: (close / lowest low of the last 252 sessions, today included - 1) x 100
metrics.interpretation: How far the stock is above its 52-week low; 30 means 30% above it.
metrics.misuse: Uses 252 sessions as one year. A stock with fewer than 252 sessions of history has no value.
metrics.evidence: verification/screener/audit/html_model.md section 2.1 lo52; report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.9.1 lo52 row

metrics.label: Relative strength vs IHSG
metrics.formula: (close[t] / close[t - N] - IHSG[t] / IHSG[t - N]) x 100 over N of the ticker's sessions
metrics.interpretation: Positive: the stock beat the index over the window, in percentage points.
metrics.misuse: A difference in percentage points, not a rank; IHSG is read on the stock's own dates (its last close on or before each date).
metrics.evidence: verification/screener/audit/html_model.md section 2.1 rs; report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.9.1 rs row

metrics.label: Volume vs prior 20-session average
metrics.formula: volume[t] / SMA(volume, 20)[t - 1]: today's volume over the average of the previous 20 sessions (the Backtest volspike ratio)
metrics.interpretation: Above 1: more volume than usual; 2: twice the usual.
metrics.misuse: The average leaves today out (as the Backtest's volume spike condition does); the Relative Volume indicator includes today, so the two differ.
metrics.evidence: verification/screener/audit/html_model.md section 2.1 volspike; report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.9.1 volspike lt/between/xa row

metrics.label: RS rank (percentile)
metrics.formula: 100 x (number of population returns strictly lower) / (P - 1), return = (close[t] / close[t - N] - 1) x 100 at each ticker's evaluation bar
metrics.interpretation: Percentile of the N-session return among the listed stocks that traded on the evaluation date and have no unadjusted price break; 100 is the strongest.
metrics.misuse: The population is fixed before any filter, so filters never move a rank; a shown stale or price-break ticker is ranked against it without joining it.
metrics.evidence: verification/screener/audit/html_model.md section 2.1 rs_rank; report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.9 rs_rank (P7)

metrics.label: Breakout above prior N-session high
metrics.formula: close > highest high of the previous N sessions (backtest core PRICE_ACTION breakout)
metrics.interpretation: A close above the range of the last N sessions.
metrics.misuse: Today's high is not in the window, so a close can exceed it; equal to the Donchian upper band read on the previous bar.

metrics.label: Breakdown below prior N-session low
metrics.formula: close < lowest low of the previous N sessions (the Donchian lower band I10 at the lag the probe derives, 1)
metrics.interpretation: A close below the range of the last N sessions.
metrics.misuse: Symmetric to breakout; not a Backtest condition (Send to Backtest leaves it out).
metrics.evidence: verification/screener/audit/html_model.md section 2.1 breakout dn; report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.9.1 breakout row

metrics.label: Volume spike
metrics.formula: volume / SMA(volume, N) of the previous bar > threshold (backtest core PRICE_ACTION volspike)
metrics.interpretation: Volume well above the average of the previous N sessions.
metrics.misuse: The average excludes today; threshold is a ratio (2 = twice the average), not a percent.

metrics.label: SMA golden cross
metrics.formula: SMA(fast) crosses above SMA(slow) (backtest core PRICE_ACTION macross golden_cross)
metrics.interpretation: The fast average moved above the slow one on that bar.
metrics.misuse: SMA only; for an EMA or a mixed cross, cross a Simple or Exponential Moving Average with a second one.

metrics.label: MACD bullish divergence
metrics.formula: a swing low (3 bars each side) lower than the previous swing low within 40 bars while the MACD line makes a higher low; flagged 3 bars after the low (backtest core bullishDivergence)
metrics.interpretation: Price makes a lower low while momentum does not: selling pressure fading.
metrics.misuse: Flagged with a 3-bar delay by construction (it uses no later data); a signal on the evaluation bar refers to a low 3 sessions earlier.

metrics.label: Bollinger squeeze
metrics.formula: I29 bandwidth (length, std_dev, close, SMA basis) <= its lowest value of the last `lookback` sessions, today included
metrics.interpretation: Bands at their narrowest of the look-back: volatility contracted, often before a larger move.
metrics.misuse: Says nothing about the direction of the next move; combine with a breakout.
metrics.evidence: verification/screener/audit/html_model.md section 2.1 bb squeeze; report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.9.1 bb squeeze row

metrics.label: Stochastic %K crosses above %D below the zone
metrics.formula: I15 %K crosses above %D on a bar where %K < zone_max
metrics.interpretation: A bullish stochastic cross while still oversold.
metrics.misuse: "%K below" defaults to 25, as the prototype coded it; the prototype's label said "below 20", and the label now follows the coded test.
metrics.evidence: verification/screener/audit/html_model.md section 2.1 stoch kxd_os; report UNKNOWNS P22 item 8

metrics.label: New N-session high of a line
metrics.formula: x > the highest x of the previous `length` sessions, on every such bar; x = the chosen bar field or registry output at its start parameters
metrics.interpretation: The prototype's "OBV makes an N-session high": a line above its recent range.
metrics.misuse: Offset-invariant on cumulative lines (it compares the line with its own recent values), so it does not depend on where history starts.
metrics.evidence: verification/screener/audit/html_model.md section 2.2 obv high; report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.9.1 obv high row

metrics.label: Silent accumulation
metrics.formula: SMA(volume, days)[t] / SMA(volume, length)[t - days] >= volx and |close[t] / close[t - days] - 1| x 100 <= move
metrics.interpretation: Volume picks up while price barely moves: possible quiet accumulation.
metrics.misuse: A price-and-volume pattern only; it does not read broker data.
metrics.evidence: verification/screener/audit/html_model.md section 2.2 silent; report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.9.1 silent row

metrics.label: Close above the Ichimoku cloud
metrics.formula: close > max(span A, span B) of the cloud computed 26 bars earlier (prototype ICHI)
metrics.interpretation: Price above the cloud: an established uptrend in Ichimoku terms.
metrics.misuse: Not offered until a later release of the indicator list adds Ichimoku to the Terminal's indicators.
metrics.evidence: verification/screener/audit/html_model.md section 2.1 ichimoku; report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.9.1 ichimoku row
metrics.decision: Ichimoku is not among the 53 indicators yet: it comes with a later release of the indicator list.

metrics.label: Tenkan crosses above Kijun
metrics.formula: Tenkan (midpoint of 9) crosses above Kijun (midpoint of 26) (prototype ICHI)
metrics.misuse: Not offered until a later release of the indicator list adds Ichimoku to the Terminal's indicators.
metrics.evidence: verification/screener/audit/html_model.md section 2.1 ichimoku; report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.9.1 ichimoku row
metrics.decision: Ichimoku is not among the 53 indicators yet: it comes with a later release of the indicator list.

metrics.label: Last close
metrics.formula: close of the ticker's evaluation bar (its last bar on or before E)
metrics.interpretation: The price the screen evaluates at.
metrics.misuse: A stale stock's last close is older than the evaluation date (its row carries the Stale remark).
metrics.evidence: report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.7 universe attributes, 6.12; API CONTRACT 8.4 universe body

metrics.label: 1-day change
metrics.formula: (close[at] / close[at - 1] - 1) x 100
metrics.misuse: On the ex-date of an unadjusted corporate action the move is distorted (its row carries the Price break remark).
metrics.evidence: report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.7 universe attributes, 6.12; API CONTRACT 8.4 universe body

metrics.label: Average daily value (20 sessions)
metrics.formula: SMA(close x volume, 20) at the evaluation bar (backtest core signals.ts liquidity)
metrics.interpretation: Liquidity: the average rupiah traded per session over 20 sessions.
metrics.misuse: Close x volume approximates traded value (median ratio 1.0001 to the Regular value); never broker-lagged.
metrics.evidence: report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.7 universe attributes, 6.12; API CONTRACT 8.4 universe body; verification/screener/audit/fundamentals_universe.md section 4.1

metrics.label: History length
metrics.formula: number of the ticker's published bars
metrics.interpretation: How much price history the ticker has; censored at the first price year (2018-01-02).
metrics.misuse: Not the listing age: history before 2018 is not published.
metrics.evidence: report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.7 universe attributes, 6.12; API CONTRACT 8.4 universe body

metrics.label: Index membership (LQ45, IDX30, IDX80, ISSI)
metrics.formula: effective-dated index constituents
metrics.interpretation: Membership of a stock index on the evaluation date.
metrics.misuse: No source exists: no table or column holds constituents.
metrics.unavailable_reason: No index constituent data exists yet.

metrics.label: Listing board (Main, Development)
metrics.formula: the stock's listing board
metrics.misuse: The board a trade is made on (Regular, Nego, Tunai) is a different thing and must not be used for it.
metrics.unavailable_reason: No listing-board data exists yet.

metrics.label: Special notation / FCA
metrics.formula: IDX special notation and full call auction flags
metrics.misuse: No source exists; the prototype's filter, on by default there, is off here, so it never silently does nothing.
metrics.unavailable_reason: No special-notation data exists yet.

metrics.label: Market cap
metrics.formula: close x shares outstanding on the same split basis
metrics.misuse: Shares must be on the price's split basis; the plan for the shares-outstanding data still waits for approval.
metrics.unavailable_reason: Market cap waits for its shares-outstanding data (planned, not yet approved) and a decision on its size buckets.

metrics.label: P/E
metrics.formula: price / EPS (TTM or FY)
metrics.interpretation: Price paid per rupiah of earnings.
metrics.misuse: A loss gives no meaningful P/E; EPS must be from reports published by the evaluation date.
metrics.unavailable_reason: No fundamental data source exists yet; fundamentals wait for a source and a decision of their own.

metrics.label: P/B
metrics.formula: price / book value per share (equity attributable to the parent)
metrics.misuse: Equity from the latest published report only.
metrics.unavailable_reason: No fundamental data source exists yet; fundamentals wait for a source and a decision of their own.

metrics.label: PEG
metrics.formula: P/E / 3-year EPS CAGR
metrics.misuse: Needs 4 fiscal years of EPS kept as vintages.
metrics.unavailable_reason: No fundamental data source exists yet; fundamentals wait for a source and a decision of their own.

metrics.label: EV/EBITDA
metrics.formula: (market cap + debt - cash + minorities) / EBITDA
metrics.misuse: Not meaningful for banks.
metrics.unavailable_reason: No fundamental data source exists yet; fundamentals wait for a source and a decision of their own.

metrics.label: Dividend yield
metrics.formula: trailing 12-month cash dividends per share (by ex-date) / close x 100
metrics.misuse: Amounts and price must be on the same split basis (n/a when the window contains a corporate action that changes the price, such as a split).
metrics.unavailable_reason: Dividends come with Phase 2, after validation against an independent sample and the adjustment-basis rule.

metrics.label: Payout ratio

metrics.label: Years of dividends

operators.note: The 15 universal operators of verification/screener/OPERATORS.md (approved by the user 2026-11-07, K4), as the page offers them: a measure (a transform of the series, operators 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 12, 13, 14) and a test of the measured series (1, 15, 8, 5, 9, 10, 11). One source for the page's lists and the core's output-type rules (transforms.ts operatorTakes, condition.ts bindRank); a measure's unit gives the unit of its result ('diff': the unit of a difference of the series). types: the output types of OPERATORS.md section 4 (P and D also from the transform that makes them; every type from flow-kinds.json for the Terminal's flow indicators, EXEC-SCREENER-FLOW-CANDLES P5a); not_on lists the types a measure or test is not offered on (section 4), not_against_value the types a test takes only against a second series. forms: the catalog's other transforms that follow a measure's not_on: the moving average of a series (offered in state and event tests only, the series another one is compared with) and the ratio of two series (operator 7 in its ratio form) are comparisons with another series, so a 0/1 signal takes neither.

P.words: is already set against its own history (a percentile or z-score)

D.words: is a count of consecutive sessions

K.words: is a normalised value (a percent, a ratio or an index)

Rp.words: is an amount (rupiah or lots), which grows with the stock's size

L.words: is lots per transaction, which depend on the price per share and are not comparable with a fixed number

H.words: is a price level, which is not comparable with a fixed value or across stocks

F.words: is a 0/1 signal, which has no magnitude

measures.label: Against its own average
measures.help: Today's value against its average of the N sessions before today: difference, ratio or percent.

measures.label: Percentile of its own history
measures.help: Where today's value stands among its own last N sessions, 0 to 100.

measures.label: Change, in its own unit
measures.help: Today's value minus its value N sessions ago, in the series' own unit.

measures.label: Change, in %
measures.help: The percent change over the last N sessions.

measures.label: Z-score against its own history
measures.help: How many standard deviations today's value is from its own mean of the N sessions before today.

measures.label: Compared with another series
measures.help: The difference or ratio to a second series of the same unit. To test a cross of the two series, use the difference with "Crosses a value" at 0.

measures.label: Slope (trend per session)
measures.help: The straight-line trend of the last N sessions, per session.

measures.label: Acceleration (change of the slope)
measures.help: The slope of the last N sessions minus the slope of the N before.

measures.label: Distance to its high or low
measures.help: How far today's value is from its N-session high or low, today included.

tests.label: Above or below a value
tests.help: The measured value against a threshold.

tests.label: Inside or outside a range
tests.help: Between two values, both included, or outside them.

tests.label: Crosses a value
tests.help: Crossed above or below a threshold within the last N sessions.

tests.label: Ever in the last N sessions
tests.help: The threshold test passed (or the series crossed it) on at least one of the last N sessions.

tests.label: On K of the last N sessions
tests.help: The threshold test passed (or the series crossed it) on at least K of the last N sessions.

tests.label: N sessions in a row
tests.help: The threshold test passed on each of the last N sessions.

tests.label: Rank among the screened stocks
tests.help: The percent rank, 0 to 100, of the measured value among the stocks of your filtered universe.
